title: Croatian Oats Pilaf
description: A fresh and fluffy Croatian dish featuring ground oats, perfect for a low-carb meal prep option. This recipe is a unique twist on traditional pilaf.

ingredients.name: ground oats
ingredients.notes: rolled oats ground in a blender

instructions: In a large saucepan, bring the chicken broth to a boil over high heat.
Add the ground oats to the boiling broth, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
In a large skillet, saute the diced onion and minced garlic over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced bell pepper to the skillet and continue to cook until the pepper is tender.
Stir in the shredded chicken, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Fluff the cooked oats with a fork and stir in the chicken and vegetable mixture.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the pilaf cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for meal prep.
